title: Numerical convergence in the time step
research_question: Are E001-E003 results converged with respect to the simulation time step?
hypothesis: Grid energy and energy per successful task change by less than 0.5% between dt=0.5 s and dt=1 s for both fixed and joint policies.
evaluation_criteria: Relative difference vs dt=0.25 s per policy and seed.
known_limitations: Convergence of a time-stepped scheme does not validate the physics itself.
data_collection: Simulator outputs written to the append-only SQLite store; every metric labelled with provenance; per-run config SHA-256 and code SHA-256 recorded; time series for selected seeds.
statistics: Paired by seed (identical workload realisation across levels). Per-seed relative difference d=(A-B)/B; mean with two-sided 95% Student-t CI.
